universe_basis: Fixed current S&P 500 constituent snapshot and current GICS labels; all 500 distinct current issuers attempted, not historical membership
limitations: Current constituent snapshot and current GICS labels create survivorship and classification bias.
All distinct issuers in the fixed current snapshot are attempted; historical S&P500 membership is not reconstructed.

Corpus includes SEC Item2.02/6-K earnings releases, substantive shareholder letters and guidance updates; bounded EchoStar and T.Rowe Price exceptions use standalone EX99 releases attached to 10-K/Q. Verified official issuer IR releases/letters restore missing SEC text. Whole reports, standalone slides and independent financial tables are excluded.
IPO, spin-off, foreign-filer and successor-entity histories can leave fewer than 40 publication quarters; full-universe attempt does not imply a balanced panel.
Some Item2.02 filings are preliminary updates; more than four filings per year is possible.
Acceptance timestamp is conservative relative to the original issuer press-release time.
LM tone measures positive/negative language, not macroeconomic direction or causal impact.
Keyword topics overlap and require human-label validation before investment use.
Forward-looking text identification and boilerplate removal are rule-based heuristics.
topic_absence_policy: NaN tone when zero matching sentences; never imputed neutral
quarter_coverage_denominator_note: The Cartesian maximum assumes every current issuer existed throughout the study. Pre-IPO, pre-spin-off and successor-history quarters are not automatically missing observations.
acquisition_log_note: Unsupported or non-earnings candidate exhibits; not necessarily network errors. Some entries overlap entire-filing exclusions.
official_IR_availability_rule: For actual IR text replacements: max(original SEC acceptance, midnight America/New_York following the official IR release date). SEC acceptance retained separately; PDF metadata is only a version check.
source_audit_scope: Whole-corpus automated source/hash/timestamp/topic checks plus risk-targeted manual inspections and bounded source repairs. Not every document was manually read in full.
fomc_text_scope: Staff Review of the Economic Situation through before Committee Policy Action
exclusion_count_basis: Distinct filing/doc IDs with a rejected source: entire-filing exclusions plus filings with retained replacement sources. Not a count of every alternate exhibit URL.
